description_for_human: Compile and explore Sigil (CSSL) — an AI-first game engine language with dual x86-64 and SPIR-V compilation targets.
description_for_model: Sigil (CSSL — Caveman Sigil Substrate Language) is a hardware-grounded, AI-first programming language designed for game engines and high-performance compute. Use this plugin to: compile Sigil source code to x86-64 assembly (AVX2+FMA3) or SPIR-V (Vulkan compute shaders); look up any keyword, annotation (@differentiable, @pure, @kernel), built-in type (vec3, mat4, f32), or CSL glyph (§, W!, I>, ∀, →); retrieve curated code examples by tag (autodiff, graphics, game-engine, cssl, spirv); and fetch the formal grammar for parser or tooling work. Sigil features zero-cost dimensional analysis, coordinate space tracking, autodiff, and CSL — a compact AI-first specification notation. Also available: Getting Started guide (build from source, first program, effects, capabilities, IFC): https://cssl.dev/getting-started; Sigil by Example (https://cssl.dev/examples) — 7 sections of annotated CSSL code examples from basics through linear types, algebraic effects, SDF geometry, autodiff, quantum-inspired Krylov evolution, DCU Kuramoto synchronization, and a complete audio-synth program; Thinking Guides (https://cssl.dev/thinking-guides) — reasoning methodology for DGI with 7 failure modes, corrective protocol, and quality gates; Ethics and Morals Guides (https://cssl.dev/ethics-guides) — foundational ethical principles, moral reasoning methodology, data ethics, cognitive ethics, collaborative ethics, and anti-patterns (sycophancy, gaslighting, deference theater, epistemic cowardice) for all intelligences; FAQ (https://cssl.dev/faq) — answers to common questions about CSSL, CSL, effects, IFC, DGI, Cranelift vs LLVM, and production readiness; Contributing guide (https://cssl.dev/contributing) — project philosophy, code of conduct, development setup, code style, testing. All guides have machine-readable .txt and CSL variants. Note: CSSL (aka Sigil) is the programming language; CSL is the separate formal notation/specification system.
